checked.name: LexicalScalarProofs.checked_u32_spec
checked.precondition: Outlines the default decimal checked scalar loop from the release macro; input bytes and initial u32 value are arbitrary. This is the harness helper, not the complete parser.

checked.name: LexicalScalarProofs.checked_i32_negative_from_spec
checked.precondition: Initial i32 value is nonpositive and cursor + input length fits usize; this is the outlined negative checked scalar helper, not the complete parser.

checked.name: LexicalScalarProofs.checked_i32_positive_from_spec
checked.precondition: Initial i32 value is nonnegative and cursor + input length fits usize; this is the outlined positive checked scalar helper, not the complete parser.

checked.name: LexicalScalarProofs.checked_u8_from_spec
checked.precondition: Initial cursor plus input length fits usize; this is the outlined u8 checked scalar loop.

checked.name: LexicalScalarProofs.unchecked_u8_from_spec
checked.precondition: Initial value is zero, input length is at most two, and cursor plus length fits usize; this is the outlined u8 unchecked scalar loop.

checked.name: LexicalScalarProofs.complete_u8_success
checked.precondition: No input precondition. This proves the separately reviewed default-format u8 front-end adaptation, not the original generic parser body.

checked.name: LexicalDigitProofs.char_to_digit_const_spec
checked.precondition: Radix is between 2 and 36 inclusive; this maps an extracted lexical-util dependency body, not lexical-parse-integer source.

checked.name: LexicalScalarProofs.partial_u8_success
checked.precondition: No input precondition. This proves the separately reviewed default-format partial u8 front-end adaptation, including value, count, and error index.

checked.name: LexicalScalarProofs.complete_i8_success
checked.precondition: No input precondition. This proves the separately reviewed default-format signed i8 complete front-end adaptation, including sign, value, and error index.

checked.name: LexicalScalarProofs.partial_i8_success
